announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.8.0 — baru: PANORAMA 360. Di SketchUp klik Potret 360 (plugin ARA Scene 1.4.3, dipasang otomatis): pilih tempat simpan, lalu jadi JPEG 360 siap pakai dan langsung masuk panggung ARA dengan Mode 360 (tombol 360 hijau). Atur preset, cahaya, jam, cuaca, notasi seperti biasa, GENERATE — sambungan kiri-kanan ditambal otomatis, putar di ARA atau Ekspor ke browser untuk klien (satu berkas, tanpa internet). Studio: hapus banyak gambar sekaligus. Edisi kantor: memilih folder DESIGN kini membuka daftar proyek (perbaikan). Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.8.0 — new: PANORAMA 360. In SketchUp click 360 Capture (ARA Scene plugin 1.4.3, installed automatically): choose where to save, get a ready-to-use 360 JPEG, and it lands on the ARA stage in 360 mode (green 360 button). Set preset, light, time, weather and notes as usual, GENERATE — the left/right seam is patched automatically; spin it in ARA or Export to browser for your client (one file, no internet needed). Studio: delete many images at once. Office edition: choosing the DESIGN folder now opens the project list (fix). Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
